_about: Hand-maintained listings the collector always includes: exhibitions and ongoing volunteer roles with no single date, and events a venue only announces elsewhere. Remove an entry once it ends. Dated entries are dropped automatically once they are past.

events.desc: Sculpture exhibition by the Atlanta artist. Open Tuesday–Saturday.

events.title: Second Harvest Food Bank Warehouse Shifts
events.desc: Sort and pack food for families across Acadiana. Groups must schedule in advance, and the volunteer team asks for 48 hours to respond.

events.title: Blood Drive Volunteer with Vitalant
events.desc: Greet donors, run check-in and serve refreshments. Ages 16+, orientation provided.

events.title: Hospice Companion Volunteer
events.venue: Vital Caring Hospice, 217 Rue Louis XIV
events.desc: Spend time with patients, give caregivers a break, and help with light errands. Requires a background check and orientation.

events.title: Festival of Lights
events.desc: The Oil Center's annual holiday lighting celebration. Last year's was Friday, Dec 5, starting at 5:30 PM.
events.verify: The 2026 date hasn't been posted yet.

events.title: Thanksgiving Meal Service at St. Joseph Diner
events.venue: St. Joseph Diner, 613 W. Simcoe St
events.desc: Help serve a hot Thanksgiving meal to neighbors experiencing homelessness and hunger. Volunteers must be 7 or older, and anyone under 18 needs an adult. Sign up on the Catholic Charities of Acadiana volunteer calendar.
events.verify: Holiday shifts have filled early in past years. Sign up soon.

events.title: Red Kettle Bell Ringing
events.desc: Two-hour shifts ringing the bell for the Salvation Army's Red Kettle campaign. Funds go to food assistance, Angel Tree and local outreach.
events.verify: Listed on a volunteer aggregator. Confirm with the Salvation Army Lafayette Corps.
